notes: no model API, network, Slack, CRM, payment, call, email, or publishing side effects
Lead/entity deduplication requires stable CRM IDs or source-event IDs. Do not infer duplicate leads from names, emails hidden in summaries, or shared Slack source refs.

For assistant-loop evidence, acceptance requires no repeat of already answered fields, exact invocation triggers, freeform answers accepted when plain text supplies the field, artifact completion proven by links or receipts, and tool blockers named exactly. This replay carries that contract; it does not implement NLP detection.
